auth_type.correction: mixed: no authentication for GET endpoints; HTTP Basic Auth with a Job Board API key for application-submission POST requests

description.correction: The API is not entirely read-only: it provides public, unauthenticated GET endpoints for job-board data and an authenticated POST endpoint for submitting applications.

notes: Current 2026 official materials still document the v1 boards-api hostname and Job Board API. The announced August 31, 2026 deprecation applies to Harvest API v1/v2, not Job Board API. Greenhouse publishes paid Core, Plus, and Pro subscriptions, but does not clearly define standalone Job Board API free-tier pricing or limits. The example is structurally documented; the literal board token "example" is not established as a live board.
